title: Bladestorm
summary: Bladestorm is a powerful Blood Spiral spell that creates a onslaught of sharp blades levitating in the air.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Reportedly Rassimov's deadliest power, few have survived this attack. However, both Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill survived being attacked by Rassimov's Bladestorm spell and thus number among its few survivors. [TCG:SAS-129]

Rassimov used this power against Dante Vale as part of his numerous traps set up at the Professor's castle. Both Dante and Rassimov fought one another using a blade from the power, with Rassimov using Firebrand to halve the blade into two with a dangerous lit end. [The Divine Comedy]
